jobs.title: Young Adult Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**
Under the supervision of the Assistant Director of Shelter Services, the **Young Adult Shelter Program Manager** is responsible for the overall oversite and administration of the Young Adult Shelter program, which offers 24/7 services to youth ages 18\-24, and always ensures adequate staffing. This includes response to emergency situations, supervision of Life Skill Managers, full\-time volunteers, and relief staff. The Young Adult Shelter Program Manager is also responsible for the oversight of HMIS/Salesforce data quality, QMAP requirements, maintenance of physical space, as well as oversight of youth activities and working closely with the Assistant Director of Shelter Services to assist with shelter program development.  

In addition, they will act as liaison between the Volunteer Coordinator and volunteers at the shelter, communicating needs and ensuring all volunteers feel welcome and have an understanding of the Young Adult Shelter.  

This role will also be responsible for oversight and understanding of health department regulations, as well as training new staff in their positions. They will ensure that interactions, interventions and environments at Urban Peak are trauma informed and emphasize the physical and emotional safety of youth and staff. **Who You Are:*** A master’s degree in social work, psychology, or child development AND a minimum of two (2\) years’ treatment\-oriented or case management experience; OR a bachelor’s degree in behavioral science, human services, or related fields AND three (3\) years’ experience working with children/youth; OR 5 years’ full\-time (FT) experience with homeless or runaway youth.
* Experience supervising staff and managing a residential and/or shelter program are preferred.
* Confidence in timely and accurate data collection and the ability to maintain accurate and thorough client files (this position will utilize Salesforce).
* The ability to connect well, work effectively and communicate in a culturally responsive manner with a diverse youth population.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and to assess and change priorities based upon agency and client needs, in an environment that sometimes includes interpersonal conflict and chaos.
* Skilled in mediating and de\-escalating, particularly in sensitive situations.
* Able to make sound decisions, using available information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
* Able to function as a member of an interdisciplinary team and work with collaborating agencies.
* Must be team\-oriented and able to coordinate with various departments and staff.
* Lived experience reflective of the youth we serve encouraged but not required.
* Must be computer proficient and possess experience of Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel).
* Understanding of the provision of and commitment to trauma\-informed care and positive youth development.
* Must be insurable as a driver on Urban Peak’s auto liability policy in order to conduct business on behalf of the agency or transport youth using an Urban Peak vehicle and/or an approved personal vehicle.
* Must be QMAP\-certified or eligible for QMAP certification.
* Ability to use second language in written and verbal communication is desired but not a requirement (most common languages in the Denver Metro area).
* Must pass both federal and state background checks.
* Must pass pre\-employment physical.
* Must pass pre\-employment tuberculosis (TB) screening.
* Ability to provide proof of education (HS Diploma OR Official Transcripts).

**What You Will Do:*****Milieu Supervision:**** During coverage of floor shifts or on holiday and on\-call shifts, the Young Adult Shelter Program Manager focuses their attention on providing oversight of the shelter milieu area.
* Provides services for youth through a trauma informed approach, working to ensure the physical and emotional safety of the youth and their environment.
* Provides programming that supports the building of healthy relationships, as needed.
* Works alongside kitchen staff and volunteers to ensure meals are prepared in a safe, clean, and efficient manner.
* Works with youth to maintain cleanliness of their environment. Provides direction and support to youth on the completion of daily chores.
* Maintains a welcoming presence and support youth who enter the program through intakes, tours, and bed assignments.
* Provides crisis intervention and de\-escalation support, including verbal and physical altercations, and phone counseling, as needed.

 ***Documentation:**** Ensures accurate documentation of all services (including intakes, assessments, case notes, treatment plans, as well as individual and bulk services) in Salesforce.
* Ensures all client documentation is in accordance with programmatic data quality standards.
* Obtains Releases of Information for all communication with external supports on behalf of client.
* Documents significant events and client updates in the Communication Log.
* Maintains clear and effective communication with other staff regarding clients.
* Ensures client confidentiality through the safe and secure storage of client information.
* Completes thorough intakes in a manner that begins to establish comfort and trusting relationships.
* During intake, assesses the level of need and make recommendations regarding youth’s involvement in Urban Peak. Establishes plans with youth, ensures follow through, and makes appropriate referrals.

 ***Program Oversight:**** In conjunction with the Assistant Director of Shelter Services, maintains compliance with all the various grants and their programmatic requirements, shelter licensing requirements, responds to licensing inquiries as needed and participates in audits and licensing visits
* Oversees inventory and purchasing of shelter supplies.
* Plans and coordinates position\-specific training for new hires
* Plans and facilitates Shelter meetings in coordination with Assistant Director of S

jobs.title: Supervisor, Sterile Processing (Nights)
jobs.description:
We are recruiting for a mission\-driven Supervisor, Sterile Processing (Nights) to join our team!  

  

We're with you for life’s journey. At Denver Health, purpose isn’t just something we believe in—it’s something we live every day, for life’s journey.


**Our Values**

Respect \| Belonging \| Accountability \| Transparency


**Department**

Sterile Processing
**Job Summary**  

  

Under the general management \& supervision of the Sterile Processing manager, the supervisor acts as the Sterile Processing department, clinical expert for assigned duties. The supervisor performs supports and coordinates activities in the Sterile Processing department, in reference to scheduled and unscheduled surgical case management and provides direction and guidance, to include all Ancillary and Ambulatory departments. The supervisor participates as a team member by performing all Sterile Processing duties. The supervisor assumes department management duties in absence of the Sterile Processing department manager. The supervisor monitors, educates and directs assigned sterile processing technicians to achieve optimum performance, efficiency, and quality out comes.
  

  

The supervisor performs all Sterile Processing department responsibilities and duties. Ensures all Surgical, Ambulatory clinics, and Ancillary department instruments are available for daily cases. Also participates in Sterile Processing department leadership meetings, and other scheduled meetings, to include Sterile Processing department staff interviews, education and corrective action, when necessary. This position exists to help the manager develop and supervise the staff and functions of the entire department. The supervisor runs the daily operations on their shift and develops technicians to ensure appropriate decontamination and sterilization and assists the manager with the development of policies and procedures, and implements programs associated with these responsibilities. The supervisor ensures associate safety and adherence to regulatory agency recommendations related to the processing area.  

  

  

  

**Essential Functions** :


* Supervises functions of staff in department to meet CDC, OSHA, EPA, AAMI, State, APIC, and Joint Commission guidelines and standards, as required. (10%)
* Assist with establishing policies and procedures for decontaminating, setting up and sterilization of instruments and equipment. Supervisors shall maintain a safe, functional and effective work environment for patients, staff and other individuals. (10%)
* Responsible for the safe and efficient practices for decontamination, instrument assembly, and sterilization of all reprocessed instruments and equipment. (10%)
* Maintain twenty four (24\) hour, seven days a week and accountability for all personnel and activities occurring in the Sterile Processing department. (10%)
* Provide direct and effective supervision to ensure timely delivery of clean and/or sterile instrumentation and medical equipment. (10%)
* The supervisors shall actively support and pursue quality improvement for the department and organization. The supervisors shall analyze the department daily needs, and study new products equipment and techniques. (10%)
* Maintain adequate department staffing levels to ensure daily operation services to the Operating Room. (5%)
* Partner with the Sterile Processing site manager in evaluating change in policies and procedures, and implements appropriate systems to accommodate these changes. (5%)
* Conduct departmental orientation, training, skills review, and assists the site manager with educational programs to maintain high staff performance standards. (5%)
* Assist with recruitment and selection of new employees. Provide feedback for use in staff probationary and annual Performance Evaluation. (5%)
* Monitor inventory levels to ensure adequate supplies, preventing waste and controlling costs. (5%)
* Assist the site manager, as assigned, in developing and reporting quality assurance reports to appropriate committees. (5%)
* Provide ongoing communications with staff and management of all Ambulatory \& Ancillary departments on a daily basis. (5%)
Provide a forum for staff involvement in problem identification and resolution. The Supervisors will meet regularly with management to share information regarding department activities. (5%)  
* 

  

**Education** :


* High School Diploma or GED **required**

  

**Work Experience** :


* 1\-3 years Sterile Processing experience **required**

\- and \-


Supervisor experience preferred  

* 

  

**Licenses** :


* CSPDT\-Certified SPD Technician \- CBSPD \- Certification Board for Sterile Processing \& Distribution **required**

\- Or \-


* CRCST\-Certified Registered Central Service Technician \- Tradesmen International **required**

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Demonstrates knowledge and practices of the Denver Health values on a daily basis, by treating patients, family members and colleagues with respect.
* The supervisor will demonstrate safety knowledge to reduce risk.
* Ability to carry out professional standards, statutes, regulations, hospital and departmental policies and standards of care.
* Maintain effective communication with all hospital leadership, with all physicians, co\-workers, patients and visitors to promote patient safety and satisfaction.
* Apply basic knowledge of anatomy and physiology to their day to day functions.
* The supervisor will have the ability and understanding to clean assemble \& sterilize instrumentation to be used to administer patient care.
* Ability to research Intentions for usage standard for all instruments used in the Operating Room, and throughout the hospital.
* Supervisors will work closely with surgeons to request equipment, products, instrumentation and supplies.
* Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, Sterile Processing Microsystems, Centricity Time and Attendance, One Source document management and Policy Stat.

*

The **Court Services Case Manager** performs professional case management work. Work involves individually managing and coordinating a large caseload of adults, and occasionally juveniles, who have been ordered to perform community service. Responsible for screening, interviewing and evaluating clients to determine their suitability for placement at approved non\-profit, charitable, governmental agencies and/or on supervised work crews. Works with a variety of county officials and agencies; preparing a variety of documents for county and other officials, and for community, non\-profit and charitable organizations. Assists with preparation of projects for work crew programs. Appear when summoned by the court.

Hiring Range: $26\.00 \- $28\.000 USD Annual

Jefferson County offers a generous benefits package that supports your personal and professional life. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid time off and holidays, including **a starting bank of 40 hours of PTO for new hires**; retirement matching; wellness programs; tuition reimbursement and more. For more information, click here for our Total Rewards summary.

Maintain contact with community service clients to monitor their case status and their compliance with conditions ordered by the courts.

Coordinate with the Courts, Probation Department, Diversion Office, other Colorado counties on client case status. jobs.title: Life Enrichment and Volunteer Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a position at a mission\-driven, innovative organization with great benefits? If so, join Boulder Housing Partners! We are a PERA employer and offer great public employee retirement benefits, health and wellness benefits, work\-life balance, and flexible schedules.


We build, own, and manage affordable housing in the City of Boulder, bringing together staff and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds to accomplish a common goal.

**OVERALL JOB OBJECTIVE**: Under general supervision, the Life Enrichment and Volunteer Coordinator plans, organizes, and recruits, trains, and supports volunteers to implement activities to promote social interaction, physical health, mental stimulation, and help promote healthy communities at BHP’s housing communities. The populations served are people living independently and include people with special needs such as seniors, people with disabilities, people who have experienced homelessness, and families. Responsibilities include conducting research to determine resident interests; partnering with organizations and volunteers to provide onsite activities, promoting resident involvement in community development, and supporting resident leadership.

  



**HIRING RANGE AND BENEFITS**:


$25 \- $29/hour DOQ


Applications will be accepted through September 10th, 2026\.


We know our employees are our most important resource, in addition to rewarding and meaningful work we enjoy:

* Medical, dental, vision health plans.
* Retirement benefits that include PERA defined benefit plan plus 401k and 457 plans.
* Paid life insurance.
* Employee wellness program.
* Paid Long term disability
* 13 paid holidays per year plus vacation and sick leave.
* Select Summer Fridays off (if applicable)
* Excellent work\-life programs, such as flexible schedules, training opportunities, and more.
* For more info please click here.

 **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**:


1\. Activities Planning and Coordination

* Collaborate with staff, residents, community partners, and volunteers to develop a comprehensive activities program that aligns with residents’ interests and preferences.
* Plan, organize, and implement, with volunteer and resident support, a diverse range of activities, including exercise classes, arts and crafts sessions, educational workshops, safety seminars, cultural events, outings, and entertainment programs.
* Ensure activities are inclusive and cater to the varying abilities and interests of residents.

2\. Engagement and Participation

* Build relationships with residents to understand their preferences, needs, and feedback regarding the activities program.
* Promote resident engagement and participation in activities through effective communication, encouragement, and enthusiasm.
* Create and maintain marketing materials and calendars to promote resident engagement.


3\. Volunteer Coordination

* Recruit, train, supervise, and appreciate activity assistants or volunteers to support organizing and running programs.
* Develop resident leadership as a source of volunteer support.
* Delegate tasks and responsibilities effectively to ensure smooth execution of activities.
* Provide ongoing feedback, training, and support to direct reports to enhance their performance.


4\. Resource Management

* Coordinate logistics such as venue booking, equipment setup, and transportation.
* Manage resources efficiently, including budgets, supplies, equipment, and external vendors or performers for special events.
* Maintain accurate records of expenses, attendance, and feedback to assess the effectiveness of activities and make necessary adjustments.


5\. Collaboration and Communication

* Collaborate with other staff members, residents, volunteers, and external stakeholders to support the activities program and enhance the overall resident experience.
* Communicate regularly with residents and staff to keep them informed about upcoming activities, events, and any changes to the schedule.
* Solicit input and suggestions from residents and incorporate their ideas into the activities program whenever possible.


6\. Safety and Well\-being

* Prioritize the safety and well\-being of residents during all activities and outings, ensuring that appropriate precautions are taken to prevent accidents or injuries.
* Stay informed about relevant health and safety guidelines, particularly regarding seniors’ specific needs and limitations.
* Identify residents in need of supportive services and refer them to a BHP Resident Services Coordinator.


7\. Continuous Improvement

* Evaluate the effectiveness of the activities program on an ongoing basis, based on feedback from residents, attendance, and outcomes for each activity or event.
* Use feedback and data to continuously improve and refine activity offerings.
* Stay current on trends and best practices in resident engagement, community\-based programming, healthy aging, accessibility, and inclusive activities programming. Incorporating innovative ideas and innovations into the program as appropriate.


8\. Represent BHP through participation in professional organizations, meetings, and public speaking events.


9\. Perform related duties as assigned to support departmental and organizational needs.


10\. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this position. Regular schedule may vary based on program needs and may occasionally include evening or weekend activities and events.


11\. Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and excellent customer service.


12\. Support BHP’s mission, values, and safety standards.

 **COMPETENCIES**:


Interpersonal Skills – Commits to finding ways to work with a wide array of people and finds ways to adjust to working in different situations and with people who have different styles.


Peer Relationships – Can quickly find common ground and solve problems for the good of all, can solve problems with peers with a minimum of noise, is seen as a team player and is cooperative,

jobs.title: Licensed School Social Worker
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Licensed School Social Worker to join our educational team. In this vital role, you will provide comprehensive social, emotional, and behavioral support to students, ensuring their well\-being and academic success. Your expertise will help create a positive, inclusive school environment where every student feels valued and supported. You will collaborate closely with teachers, families, and community resources to address individual student needs, promote mental health, and uphold educational compliance standards. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of children from diverse backgrounds.

**Duties**

* Conduct thorough assessments of students’ social, emotional, and behavioral health needs using evidence\-based practices.
* Develop and implement individualized support plans aligned with Multi\-tiered Systems of Support (MTSS) frameworks to address varying levels of student needs.
* Provide crisis intervention and management for students experiencing mental health or behavioral emergencies, ensuring safety and stability.
* Collaborate with educators, families, child protective services, and community agencies to coordinate comprehensive support strategies for students with disabilities or in need of child welfare services.
* Facilitate conflict management sessions and cultural diversity counseling to foster an inclusive school climate.
* Assist in navigating special education processes and ensure compliance with educational regulations while advocating for student rights.
* Offer ongoing counseling sessions focused on behavioral health, mental health care, and social skills development to promote positive student outcomes.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of child protective services protocols and child welfare laws.
* Expertise in crisis intervention techniques and crisis management strategies.
* Experience working with students with disabilities and understanding of special education requirements.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with teachers, families, healthcare providers, and other professionals for holistic student support.
* Proficiency in working with children from diverse cultural backgrounds and providing culturally sensitive counseling.
* Familiarity with Childcare practices, behavioral health principles, and mental health care approaches within educational settings.
* Knowledge of educational compliance standards and regulations relevant to school social work practice.
* Excellent conflict management skills combined with teaching abilities to foster positive behavioral change.

Join us in making a lasting impact by supporting students’ social\-emotional development while ensuring their safety and well\-being within a dynamic school environment!

Pay: $50\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

* Vision insurance

jobs.description:

Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. The typical candidate is hired below midpoint of the range.


Experience the HCA Healthcare difference where colleagues are trusted, valued members of our healthcare team. Grow your career with an organization committed to delivering respectful, compassionate care, and where the unique and intrinsic worth of each individual is recognized. Submit your application for the opportunity below: Social Worker MSW

##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**


The Social Worker (MSW) is responsible for non\-clinical, biopsychosocial assessments and interventions for the inpatient floors and the outpatient emergency department. The MSW performs crisis intervention, patient/family interventions, high\-risk screening, focused emotional support, and referrals for financial assistance or other identified resource needs. The MSW assists in post\-acute care placement on all discharges, primarily with those patients identified with post\-discharge behavioral health and patient assistance/resource needs. The MSW is dedicated to patient and family\-centered care that values personal self\-determination, prioritization, and engages in creative and compassionate problem\-solving. The scope of this role includes intensive care units, Trauma, Oncology, NICU, Transplant, and ED. The MSW responds to physician, non\-discharge planning social work consults throughout the facility.


What you will do in this role:

* You will work collaboratively with RN case managers, acute care nurses, physicians, insurance companies, and other staff members to proactively identify and address patient needs.
* You will identify and address barriers to discharge and recovery. These barriers include financial, emotional, psychosocial, medical, and spiritual.
* You will maintain a thorough working knowledge of the rules of Medicare, Medicaid, and private payer regulations and processes. You will possess a thorough understanding of managed\-care concepts and length\-of\-stay management relating to patient and organizational fiscal responsibility.
* You will perform thorough assessments and develop appropriate discharge plans for high\-risk patients with discharge planning or psychosocial needs.
* You will coordinate and facilitate meetings between the care team and patients/families/caregivers. You will assist patients and families in making difficult decisions while honoring their preferences and values.
* You will intervene with patients/families/caregivers for psychosocial needs, assistance, and support in coping with chronic acute terminal illness. You will engage in consultation, discharge planning, education, counseling, advocacy, and information referrals to meet the emotional, social, and financial aspects of care.
* You will provide emotional support to patients and family members during complex and/or emotionally charged issues, such as end\-of\-life, terminal illness notifications, death notification (with physician), and crisis interventions.

###### **What qualifications you will need:**

* Masters Degree
* 1 years experience Required Years of Experience or MSW internship required

##### **Benefits**


HCA HealthONE Aurora, offers a total rewards package that supports the health, life, career and retirement of our colleagues. The available plans and programs include:

* **Comprehensive benefits** for medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, behavioral health and telemedicine services
* **Wellbeing support,** including free counseling and referral services
* **Time away from work** programs for paid time off, paid family leave, long\- and short\-term disability coverage and leaves of absence
* **Savings and retirement resources**, including a 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, flexible spending accounts, preferred banking partnerships, retirement readiness tools, rollover support and financial wellbeing counseling
* **Education support** through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
* **Additional benefits** for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts


Learn more about Employee Benefits

***Note: Eligibility for benefits may vary by location.***

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Specialist - RBT (Greeley,CO)
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) seeking the ideal organization to join? We're actively seeking enthusiastic and devoted RBTs to become valued members of our team, contributing your expertise to support our clients in achieving their unique goals. As an accomplished professional in the Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) field, your skills and dedication align with our dedication to providing excellence to our clients.


**Perks:**


* ### **Same Day Pay!** **No more waiting for payday — now you can access a portion of your paycheck** **right after you clock in and out****. Whether it’s an emergency or you just need funds sooner, you’ll have the flexibility to get paid** **immediately****.**


Your time. Your money. On your schedule.
* Elevate your career with job stability and opportunities for professional advancement in the thriving ABA industry.
* Enjoy the flexibility and autonomy you deserve, catering to your schedule and professional preferences.
* Receive competitive compensation that reflects your experience.
* Ideal for those seeking part\-time positions.
* Access career advancement assistance through partnerships with BCBA schooling programs.
* Benefit from a robust clinical team dedicated to providing the support you deserve.
* Fellowship and internship opportunities to accumulate both restricted and unrestricted hours.
* Enjoy the freedom to choose your own cases, without a minimum case requirement.
* Earn referral bonuses by spreading the word about our opportunities.

**Responsibilities:**


* Provide one\-on\-one ABA services to clients, using evidence\-based interventions supporting independence and positive behavior.
* Serve as an integral member of our clinical team, responsible for the direct implementation of skill\-building and care plans.
* Record session data accurately using electronic devices.
* Foster a positive learning environment for clients and connect with families.

**Qualifications:**


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willingness to learn and passionate about making a difference for children with Autism.
* Patience, compassion, and the ability to maintain a calm demeanor in challenging situations.
* RBT certification is required before working

**Need to Know:**


* Services will be provided in clients' homes or in community\-based locations.
* All positions start off part\-time.
* Looking to hire candidates who are willing to make a 6\-month commitment to change our clients lives.

**Great Fit If You Have Experience In:**


* Education or early childhood development
* Childcare, babysitting, or youth mentorship
* Teaching assistant, paraprofessional, or instructional aide roles
* After\-school programs or camp counseling
* Behavioral health, mental health, or social services
* ABA therapy or working with individuals with Autism
* Healthcare support (DSP, CNA, HHA, PCA, caregiver)
* Supporting a neurodiverse family member or loved one

**No experience? No problem — paid training is provided!**  

If you're compassionate, patient, and passionate about making a difference, we encourage you to apply.


Join our team, contribute your skills to our mission, and continue your journey of making a meaningful difference in the lives of children with Autism. Apply today and be a part of our dynamic and fulfilling community!

jobs.title: Chronic Care Management and RPM Telehealth Clinics Manager/supervisor
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Chronic Care Management and RPM Telehealth Clinics Manager/Supervisor to lead our innovative telehealth initiatives focused on chronic disease management. In this role, you will oversee the daily operations of remote patient monitoring (RPM) and chronic care management programs, ensuring high\-quality patient care, compliance with healthcare regulations, and efficient team performance. Your leadership will drive the success of our telehealth clinics by coordinating clinical workflows, supervising multidisciplinary teams, and implementing best practices aligned with industry standards. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes through cutting\-edge telehealth solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and supervise clinical teams providing chronic care management and RPM services, including nurses, social workers, behavioral health specialists, and administrative staff.
* Develop, implement, and monitor care plans tailored to individual patient needs, ensuring adherence to clinical protocols and regulatory standards such as NCQA and HIPAA.
* Oversee data collection, documentation review, and medical records management to ensure accuracy and compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, and other healthcare policies.
* Coordinate discharge planning, utilization review, and case management activities for patients transitioning across acute care settings such as hospitals, ICU, PICU, or home health services.
* Ensure team adherence to healthcare management best practices by providing ongoing training in medical terminology, physiology, anatomy, behavioral health counseling, and social work principles.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and supervise workflow optimization to enhance patient care delivery efficiency.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of healthcare regulations including HIPAA privacy rules, Medicaid policies, NCQA standards, and hospital/healthcare accreditation requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in managing telehealth clinics or healthcare programs with a focus on chronic disease management or remote patient monitoring.
* Extensive background in clinical case management within hospital medicine, ICU, Level I/II trauma centers, or home health environments.
* Strong supervisory skills with demonstrated success in team leadership and staff development in healthcare settings.
* Familiarity with managed care systems including Medicaid and Medicare regulations; experience with utilization review is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of behavioral health counseling, addiction counseling, mental health therapy, and social work practices relevant to patient care coordination.
* Ability to interpret medical terminology accurately; experience with discharge planning and managing medical records is essential.
* Excellent understanding of healthcare policies related to HIPAA compliance, NCQA standards for quality assurance, and healthcare regulation policies.
* Leadership qualities combined with a passion for improving patient outcomes through innovative telehealth solutions; ability to adapt quickly in a fast\-paced environment.

Join us as we revolutionize chronic care management through telehealth! Your expertise will empower patients to achieve better health outcomes while advancing your career in a forward\-thinking organization dedicated to excellence in healthcare delivery.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Member Intake Specialist (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**


At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole\-person, value\-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

 **About the Role**


The Member Intake Specialist team member plays a critical role in supporting prospective community members throughout their journey into care while ensuring operational workflows are completed accurately and efficiently. This position combines member engagement, administrative support, insurance verification, lead management, and scheduling support to help provide a seamless experience for prospective members and support the success of the Access Team.


Working closely with prospective community members, this role ensures appointments are prepared, onboarding requirements are completed, insurance is verified, leads receive timely follow\-up, and members receive compassionate guidance throughout the enrollment process. This position also supports inbound member inquiries and proactive outreach efforts to improve access to care and achieve organizational scheduling and engagement goals.


This position reports to the Access Team Supervisor. **This is a part\-time role at 24 hours per week, working three 8\-hour shifts each Saturday, Sunday, and Monday.**

**What You'll Do**

* Understand Eleanor Health's whole\-person care model and communicate its value in a compassionate, professional, and non\-judgmental manner.
* Build trust with prospective community members while guiding them through the intake and scheduling process.
* Respond to inbound inquiries regarding Eleanor Health's services and assist individuals in determining appropriate care options.
* Schedule intake appointments and coordinate services using Athena Health and other scheduling platforms.
* Verify insurance eligibility using approved verification tools and accurately document insurance information.
* Explain insurance benefits, coverage, and financial responsibility in an easy\-to\-understand manner.
* Identify and resolve insurance discrepancies whenever possible before scheduled appointments.
* Process self\-scheduled appointments by reviewing onboarding requirements, preparing appointments, and ensuring all necessary information is completed prior to clinical visits.
* Complete administrative onboarding activities, including updating member records, assigning providers, verifying communication consents, sending patient portal invitations, requesting insurance documentation, and preparing appointments for clinical teams.
* Utilize Salesforce to document all member interactions, complete workflow tasks, manage outreach activities, and maintain accurate lead records.
* Create and assign outreach tasks when additional follow\-up is required due to incomplete onboarding, missing insurance information, or unsuccessful member contact.
* Conduct outbound outreach through phone, SMS, and email to engage prospective community members, answer questions, and encourage completion of onboarding requirements.
* Support lead management by reviewing and following up on prospective member leads, documenting outcomes, scheduling follow\-up activities, and maintaining accurate lead statuses.
* Coordinate self\-pay discussions and assist prospective members in understanding available payment options when applicable.
* Communicate appropriately with out\-of\-network members by following established workflows and providing alternative resources when Eleanor Health is unable to provide services.
* Assist prospective members with virtual appointment preparation, including patient portal registration and telehealth readiness.
* Schedule Group OBAT appointments when appropriate and educate prospective members on Eleanor Health's group treatment model.
* Collaborate closely with clinical teams, financial services, and operational partners to ensure prospective members receive timely access to care.
* Identify barriers that may impact scheduled appointments and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation in Athena Health, Salesforce, and other required systems.
* Ensure all work is completed in accordance with Eleanor Health policies, workflows, compliance standards, and quality expectations.
* Contribute to reducing scheduling backlogs, improving conversion opportunities, and creating a seamless experience for prospective community members.

**Who You Are**

* Has 2–4 years of customer service, healthcare administration, scheduling, or contact center experience.
* Has previous experience in behavioral health, substance use treatment, medical scheduling, or healthcare operations preferred.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Has experience using electronic medical records (EMRs), CRM systems, and scheduling platforms.
* Possesses excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Has outstanding customer service and active listening abilities.
* Is compassionate, empathetic, resilient, and non\-judgmental.
* Can effectively explain complex topics, including insurance and treatment options, in a simple and supportive manner.
* Is highly self\-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Has strong critical\-thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Is proficient with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.


Preferred:

* Experience using Athena Health and Salesforce.
* Experience verifying medical insurance eligibility
